definitions: In cricket, one of the two sets of three stumps with two bails on top, defended by a batsman.
In cricket, the area of ground between the two wickets.
In cricket, the dismissal of a batsman, or the taking of a set of stumps.
A small door or gate, especially one forming part of a larger one.
A small window or opening, especially one in a bank or post office through which business is transacted.
examples: The bowler aimed for the wicket.
The pitch was a good wicket for batting.
He took five wickets in the match.
They entered through the wicket gate.
Please approach the next available wicket.
